title: Hearty Dutch Pork Tenderloin Tart
description: A rich and silky Dutch dish featuring pork tenderloin in a flaky crust, served in a scallop shell vessel, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a large rectangle.
In a large skillet, saute the onion and mushrooms in a little bit of oil until softened.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Season the pork tenderloin with salt and pepper.
Place the pork tenderloin in the center of the pastry rectangle.
Spoon the onion and mushroom mixture over the pork tenderloin.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the beaten egg.
Roll the pastry over the filling, starting with one long side.
Place the tart in a scallop shell vessel and brush the top with the remaining egg.
Bake the tart for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
